prompt: In August of 2024, what is the first name of the mayor of the U.S. state capital city who attended the same university as at least one U.S. president and whose city is home to an outgoing or former full member of the Big 12 Conference
answer:
The mayor’s first name is **Leirion**—**Leirion Gaylor Baird**, mayor of Lincoln, Nebraska.

- She attended **Yale University**, as did several U.S. presidents.
- Lincoln is home to the **University of Nebraska–Lincoln**, a former full member of the **Big 12 Conference**.
